scripts.script:
local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

getgenv().boxfarm = true

while getgenv().boxfarm do
    LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-80, 6, 97)
    task.wait(1.4)
    fireproximityprompt(game:GetService("Workspace").BoxStocker.Box.Node.ProximityPrompt)
    wait(1.4)
    LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-98, 6, 63)
    task.wait(1.4)
    fireproximityprompt(game:GetService("Workspace").BoxStocker.Pallet.Node.ProximityPrompt)
    task.wait(1.2)
end
